query: Death Valley Furnace Creek DEVC1 station highest daily maximum temperature recorded so far July 2026, actual observations July 7-13 2026
answer:
Research complete. Here's the summary of findings on the Death Valley Furnace Creek (DEVC1) station highest daily maximum temperature for July 2026:

**Highest so far in July 2026 (month-to-date through July 16): 121°F (~49.4°C) on July 15, 2026.**

**Within the July 7–13, 2026 window specifically: peak of 119°F (~48.3°C)**, reached on July 9, 10, and 11.

**Daily highs, July 7–13, 2026:**
- Jul 7: 117°F
- Jul 8: 117°F
- Jul 9: 119°F
- Jul 10: 119°F
- Jul 11: 119°F
- Jul 12: 113°F

After a dip on July 12–13, temperatures rebounded to 115°F (Jul 14) and reached the month-to-date maximum of 121°F (Jul 15), then 120°F (Jul 16).

**Key context:**
- The 121°F peak is well within normal July climatology (average July high ~116°F; typical July record highs run 127–130°F; all-time record 134°F on July 10, 1913). July 2026 is **not** setting records.
- Data was cross-validated against AccuWeather's July 2026 Celsius daily values, which matched within rounding.
- Latest available observation was July 16, 2026 (accessed July 20, 2026); July 17–19 daily climate data was not yet posted.

**Interpretation note:** If "so far" means through mid-window (July 13), the answer is **119°F**; if it means the latest month-to-date value, it's **121°F (July 15)**.
